bihar_raw_news.content: "We plan to expand our organisation in Uttar Pradesh": Nishant Kumar on JDU's plan ahead of 2027 assembly elections ANI 31 Oct 2026, 19:03 GMT+10 Patna (Bihar) [India], October 31 (ANI): Bihar Health Minister Nishant Kumar on Saturday said that the Janata Dal (United) plans to expand its organisational presence in Uttar Pradesh and is considering contesting the 2027 Assembly elections as a constituent of the National Democratic Alliance (NDA). Speaking about the party's plans, Nishant Kumar said party workers and people in Uttar Pradesh had been demanding a meeting in the state for a long time, following which the party decided to organise one. "For a long time, people and party workers in Uttar Pradesh had been demanding that a meeting be held there. So, we are going to organise a meeting. Our party has its roots in Bihar, but we have also had an organisational presence in other states across the country, particularly in the Northeast," he said. He added that the party now intends to strengthen its organisational presence in Uttar Pradesh and expand its activities in the state. "We now plan to expand our organisation in Uttar Pradesh, strengthen our presence there and move forward. The Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections are scheduled for 2027, and we are considering contesting them," he said. On the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, Nishant Kumar said the party was considering contesting the polls and would make efforts to do so as an NDA constituent. "We will make an effort to contest the elections as a constituent of the NDA," he added. Nishant Kumar also congratulated the NDA candidates who won the recent MLC elections, saying the BJP's victory in two seats and JD(U)'s win in one seat reflected public appreciation for the work done by his father and the NDA over the past 20 years. "I extend my heartiest congratulations and best wishes to all the NDA candidates who won in the recent MLC elections. The two seats won by the BJP and the one seat won by us reflect the public's appreciation for the work carried out by my father and the NDA over the last 20 years," he said. "As for our losses, we will review the reasons behind them and strive to address any shortcomings," he added. national_raw_news.title: Vande Bharat Sleeper Express Between Varanasi and Delhi Flagged Off
national_raw_news.content: Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has approved the Northern Corridor of the bullet train network. He said that the Northern Corridor will start from Delhi and connect Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow and Ayodhya, before extending further to Varanasi, Patna and eventually Guwahati. While addressing the flagging off ceremony of the new Vande Bharat Sleeper Express between Varanasi and New Delhi from Banaras Railway Station, Union Minister said that once this Northern Corridor is completed in the coming years, the journey from Delhi to Lucknow will take just 2 hours and 12 minutes, while Delhi to Varanasi will take 3 hours and 33 minutes. Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw and Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath jointly flagged off the new Vande Bharat Sleeper Express between Varanasi and New Delhi. They also flagged off two new MEMU train services connecting Varanasi to enhance rail connectivity in the region. The Union Minister said that the Vande Bharat Sleeper train will prove to be an excellent transportation facility for middle-class families. He added that the train has been built using advanced, state-of-the-art technology with a primary focus on the comfort of both passengers and the crew, including the loco pilots. Speaking on the occasion CM Yogi Adityanath said that India has witnessed rapid infrastructure growth under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He added that these new rail services will significantly strengthen the connectivity in the Purvanchal region. The fully air-conditioned, 16-coach New Delhi-Varanasi Vande Bharat sleeper train has a passenger capacity of 823, with one First AC, four AC 2-Tier and 11 AC 3-Tier coaches. The two new MEMU trains connect Varanasi City Railway Station with Rajatalab and Prayagraj Rambagh with Varanasi. Earlier, Railway Minister inspected the redevelopment work of Kashi Railway Station and the under-construction Namo Setu in Varanasi today. He also reviewed the progress of the projects with railway officials. After inspection, the Railway Minister said that Namo Setu will be a combined railway and road bridge. He added that Namo Setu is being constructed keeping in mind the transportation needs of the next 100 years. The bridge will have a six-lane highway on the upper deck and four railway tracks on the lower deck.

national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Rain Forest and Vaman Vriksha Vatika at Ekta Nagar in Gujarat’s Narmada district today. The visit is a part of the ‘Rashtriya Ekta Diwas’ celebrations, marking the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Earlier in the day, the Prime Minister paid floral tributes to Sardar Patel at the Statue of Unity. He also inaugurated and laid the foundation stones for 31 tourism and infrastructure projects worth over 426 crore rupees. Out of these, 23 projects worth over 307 crore rupees were inaugurated, while foundation stones were laid for eight projects costing over 118 crore rupees. The Rain Forest is among the new tourism attractions. Spread across 12 acres, it recreates a rainforest environment with artificial rainfall. Its main attraction is a circular glass skywalk, allowing visitors to walk above the forest landscape. It has been built at a cost of over 14 crore rupees. The Prime Minister also visited the Vaman Vriksha Vatika, another nature-oriented attraction in the area. Other major projects inaugurated today include an IRCTC hotel, the Ekta Cruise, and an Eco Trail. Foundation stones were also laid for projects including the Gora-Bhanadra Road, a smart zero-waste management project, and an integrated Cactus and Butterfly Garden. This evening, the Prime Minister will participate in the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrations. The programme will feature the Ekta Parade comprising contingents from the Central and State Police Forces. A theatrical presentation on ‘Naxal Mukt Bharat’ by the National School of Drama will feature around 2,000 artistes. Additionally, cultural performances based on the theme ‘Vande Mataram’ will involve around 5,000 artistes from across the country.

national_raw_news.title: SEBI Steps Up Measures to Protect Investors from Online Financial Fraud 1 hour ago 18
national_raw_news.content: The Securities and Exchange Board of India, SEBI, is taking several steps to protect investors from online financial fraud and scams through social media. Speaking to the media in Kolkata, SEBI Chairman Mr. Tuhin Kanta Pandey said, the regulator is working to make investors more aware and ensure safer investments. As part of these efforts, SEBI is working with Google to introduce special verified badges on the Google Play Store so that people can identify genuine SEBI-related apps. SEBI has also started a WhatsApp channel on investor awareness in eleven languages, including Bengali. The SEBI Saarthi App and SEBI Check facility will help investors check and verify accounts before making transactions in the securities market. SEBI has also developed an artificial intelligence-based tool called ‘Sudarshan’. It will help identify violations and suspicious activities across social media platforms through a five-stage checking process. The regulator is also running the ‘Samajh ke Investing Simple’ campaign in different regional languages to help people understand investments better. In addition, the SCORES 2.0 portal has been introduced to help investors register complaints, including complaints related to financial fraud. Speaking about West Bengal’s economic growth, Mr. Pandey said the state’s economy is estimated to have grown by 7.6 per cent in the financial year 2025-26. He also pointed out that the number of investors from West Bengal in the securities market has increased significantly. The number has crossed 90 lakh, compared to around 12 lakh in the financial year 2014-15. Interestingly, around 36 per cent of these investors are below 30 years of age. He further said that more than 40 small and medium-sized businesses from West Bengal have raised over 1,400 crore rupees through SME Initial Public Offerings, or IPOs. These figures show the growing interest of people in the state’s financial and investment markets. Mr. Pandey said, investor awareness and protection remain SEBI’s top priorities. The regulator aims to make the securities market safer and help people make informed investment decisions. However the chairman made it clear that the revival of the century-old Calcutta Stock Exchange will depend on its ability to attract sufficient trading volumes, build a sustainable business model and make substantial investments in technology.

national_raw_news.title: Elections Are the Only Democratic Means of Changing Government: Prahlad Joshi 2 hours ago 24
national_raw_news.content: Union Minister Prahlad Joshi has said that democracy is deeply rooted in India’s traditions and values. He said, elections are the only constitutional and democratic means of changing governments in the country. He termed the opposition parties’ narrative of regime change as negative propaganda. Mr Joshi was addressing a press conference at the BJP headquarters in Jaipur today. He said, the people of the country are fully capable of choosing their government through their voting rights. He alleged that opposition parties are questioning the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls out of political frustration. The Union Minister said, India’s economy is steadily growing stronger, even as several major economies around the world face challenges. He said the country’s infrastructure and manufacturing sectors are expanding. Over the past nearly 12 years, the number of startups in India has increased from 260 to more than 2 lakh 40 thousand. Despite global challenges, India remains one of the world’s fastest-growing economies. Mr Joshi, along with Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma, flagged off the Run for Unity in Jaipur today to mark the 151st birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. On the occasion, he said the country is moving forward towards the vision of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat and Viksit Bharat. He said, Sardar Patel’s exceptional leadership and historic contribution laid the foundation for the dream of a united India. He brought together more than 500 princely states to create an integrated and united nation.

national_raw_news.title: Jammu to Host Fourth Edition of Midnight Marathon Tonight 3 hours ago 35
national_raw_news.content: Jammu is all set to host the fourth edition of the Jammu Midnight Marathon 2026 tonight, with the Traffic Police announcing major restrictions and diversions to ensure smooth conduct of the event. Akashvani Jammu Correspondent reports that around 10 thousand runners are expected to participate in various categories, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, 20-mile and full marathon events. As per the traffic advisory, vehicular movement along the marathon route will remain restricted from 11 PM onwards tonight. All lanes and by-lanes along the route will remain closed during the movement of participants. The marathon will start from Maulana Azad Stadium and cover Jewel Chowk, GGM Science College Road, Canal Head, Akhnoor Road Flyover, Muthi, Nai Basti Flyover and Gandhi Nagar before returning to the stadium. The Kunjwani-Last Morh flyover and both Tawi bridges-from Dogra Chowk to Bikram Chowk and Bikram Chowk to Green Belt Crossing-will also remain restricted for routine traffic. However, the Tawi Bridge at Sidhra and the 4th Tawi Bridge at Bhagwati Nagar will remain open for the general public. Parking facilities for participants have been arranged at the right bank of Tawi River Front near the Madal point, the left bank of Tawi River Front on the Ware House side and the Ware House. Commuters can contact the Traffic Control Unit Jammu at 0191-2459048 or 94191-47732 for assistance.

national_raw_news.title: Centre constitutes high-level committee to recommend banking reforms for Viksit Bharat 2047
national_raw_news.content: The government has constituted a High-Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat to review the country’s banking sector and recommend reforms in line with the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. The Finance Ministry said that the Committee will recommend structural, institutional, regulatory and legislative reforms to make the Indian banking sector globally competitive, financially inclusive and resilient. The Committee will be chaired by former Central Vigilance Commissioner Suresh N. Patel. Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu, former Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Indian Bank Padmaja Chunduru, and former RBI Deputy Governor N. S. Vishwanathan will be its members. The Joint Secretary (Banking) in the Department of Financial Services will serve as the Member Secretary. The Committee will have a tenure of six months. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman had announced the setting up of the Committee in her Budget speech this year. The Committee will assess existing banking practices and prudential norms, identify global best practices and examine their suitability for adoption in the Indian banking system. It will also review the existing regulatory and legal frameworks governing banks, including Regional Rural Banks and Cooperative Banks, and suggest reforms to improve efficiency and ease of banking. In addition, the Committee will prepare a roadmap for the adoption of artificial intelligence and digital innovations in banking institutions, while recommending safeguards against cyber risks.

national_raw_news.title: EAM calls for prioritising diplomacy over military solutions to resolve global conflicts at G20 m...
national_raw_news.content: India has asserted that military solutions cannot resolve global challenges and that diplomacy must be given an opportunity to address conflicts. Speaking at the first plenary session of the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Atlanta, the United States, last night, External Affairs Minister Dr S. Jaishankar stressed the need to preserve freedom of navigation and ensure an end to attacks on civilian shipping and seafarers, in accordance with international law, particularly the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS). His remarks come amid ongoing conflicts in different parts of the world, including the Russia-Ukraine war and escalating tensions in West Asia. Dr Jaishankar said that countries of the Global South are disproportionately bearing the consequences of attacks on civilian shipping and seafarers. He noted that such attacks are threatening the availability of essential commodities, including fuel, food and fertilisers, and driving up their costs. At least 22 Indians, including 14 seafarers, have lost their lives in West Asia since the conflict began in February this year. The External Affairs Minister, who reached Atlanta on Thursday, also held interactions with his counterparts from several countries ahead of the meeting. Dr Jaishankar will also participate in a QUAD Foreign Ministers’ Meeting with his counterparts from Japan, Australia and the United States on the sidelines of the G20 meeting. The United States is scheduled to host the G20 Leaders’ Summit in Miami on 14 and 15 December. Following his engagements in Atlanta, Dr Jaishankar is scheduled to travel to St John’s, Antigua and Barbuda, to lead India’s delegation to the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting, scheduled from 1 to 4 November.

national_raw_news.title: ISRO launches NVS-03 satellite to strengthen indigenous navigation capabilities; Vice President a...
national_raw_news.content: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has successfully launched its next-generation navigation satellite, NVS-03, marking a significant step towards strengthening the country’s indigenous satellite navigation capabilities. The Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle (GSLV-F18), carrying the satellite, lifted off from the Second Launch Pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh, last night. It was the 20th flight of the GSLV. The satellite was successfully separated from the launch vehicle and placed in its intended Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit. NVS-03 is the third satellite in ISRO’s second-generation navigation satellite series. It is designed to ensure continuity and improve the availability of navigation services under the Navigation with Indian Constellation (NavIC), India’s indigenous regional navigation system. The satellite carries an indigenous atomic clock along with procured atomic clocks. It also introduces the L1 frequency band, in addition to the existing L5 and S bands, enhancing the capabilities of the navigation system. These advancements are expected to strengthen India’s independent positioning, navigation and timing capabilities for civilian, strategic and security applications. Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan has congratulated the entire ISRO team on the successful launch of the GSLV-F18 mission. In a social media post, he said the achievement would further strengthen NavIC and enhance the country’s satellite-based navigation capabilities. He added that the successful mission reflected India’s growing capabilities in space technology and its commitment to self-reliance in advanced technologies. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also congratulated the scientists, engineers and the entire ISRO team on the successful launch. In a social media post, he said the mission marked an important step towards strengthening NavIC, India’s indigenous satellite navigation system. He added that NVS-03, equipped with enhanced capabilities, would further strengthen the country’s navigation infrastructure and contribute to India’s vision of self-reliance in critical and advanced technologies. ISRO Chairman Dr V. Narayanan congratulated the scientists, engineers, industrial partners and academic institutions associated with the mission. Addressing the gathering after the launch, he said the satellite, weighing approximately 2,232 kilograms, had been precisely injected into its intended transfer orbit. He also highlighted that the mission was accomplished with a turnaround time of just 56 days between two successive GSLV missions, the shortest interval achieved so far. Speaking to the media, Dr Narayanan said ISRO had placed its third indigenous atomic clock in orbit aboard NVS-03, while two indigenous atomic clocks were already functioning in orbit. He added that the satellite had been launched as part of India’s Regional Navigation Satellite System, which aims to provide navigation services across the country and up to 1,500 kilometres beyond its borders. Explaining the programme, the ISRO Chairman said it envisages a constellation of seven satellites in orbit to provide these services. He added that NVS-03 was the fourth satellite launched under the programme and that signals from four satellites could be used for multiple purposes. He said the constellation would need to be completed before navigation services could be integrated with mobile systems for wider public use.

national_raw_news.content: The nation is paying homage to the great freedom fighter Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel on his 151st birth anniversary today. The day is observed as Rashtriya Ekta Diwas, or National Unity Day. President Droupadi Murmu and Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan paid floral tributes to Sardar Patel at his statue at Patel Chowk in New Delhi. Prime Minister Narendra Modi also paid tributes to the Iron Man of India, saying that Sardar Patel dedicated his life to building a strong, prosperous and capable India. Union Home Minister Amit Shah, Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu, Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta and BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj also paid floral tributes to the great national leader. Later, Union Home Minister Amit Shah flagged off the Run for Unity at the Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium to mark Rashtriya Ekta Diwas. Speaking on the occasion, Mr Shah said Sardar Patel was a great personality who not only transformed the nation’s history but also shaped its geography. He added that India stands proudly on the global stage today because of the strong foundations laid by Sardar Patel. Popularly known as the Iron Man of India, Sardar Patel served as the country’s first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister. He played a historic role in integrating more than 560 princely states to build a united and strong India. Rashtriya Ekta Diwas celebrates his immense contribution to the political integration and unity of the country. The occasion also serves as a reminder of the importance of national unity, integrity, security and harmony in India’s diverse and vibrant society. Government institutions, schools and colleges are organising unity pledges, cultural programmes and awareness activities across the country to commemorate Sardar Patel’s ideals and legacy. The Run for Unity is also being organised at various places to spread the message of national integration, peace and brotherhood.

national_raw_news.content: EPFO to celebrate 74th Foundation Day in New Delhi tomorrow Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर EPFO to celebrate 74th Foundation Day in New Delhi tomorrow ANI | Updated: Oct 31, 2026 18:48 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 31 (ANI): The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) will celebrate its 74th Foundation Day in New Delhi on Sunday. Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Mansukh Mandaviya, will inaugurate the event. The celebration will be attended by senior officials of the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Members of the Central Board of Trustees, officers and employees of EPFO, employers, workers and other stakeholders. On the occasion, Mandaviya will launch key EPFO initiatives, including the Automatic Settlement of Eligible Inoperative EPF Accounts with balances up to Rs 1,000 and EPFO Services through WhatsApp, among others. The Union Minister will also review exhibition stalls at the venue and release a series of publications reflecting EPFO's commitment to knowledge creation, institutional learning, legal awareness and compassionate governance. The proceedings will also see Mandaviya presenting Bhavishya Nidhi Awards 2026 to recognise outstanding contributions by Regional Offices, Zonal Offices, individual officers and employees. The 74th Foundation Day celebration seeks to reaffirm that the journey of EPFO is not merely a story of institutional growth; it is a continuing commitment to ensure that the fruits of a worker's years of labour translate into security, dignity and peace of mind for the worker and the family. national_raw_news.content: Union Minister JP Nadda administers Rashtriya Ekta Diwas pledge to commemorate the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर Union Minister JP Nadda administers Rashtriya Ekta Diwas pledge to commemorate the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel ANI | Updated: Oct 31, 2026 12:56 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 31(ANI): Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare, J P Nadda, on Saturday administered the Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) pledge to officers and officials of both the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and the Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilisers at a ceremony held at Kartavya Bhawan-1. The observance commemorated the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, whose contributions to the integration and unity of the nation remain an enduring inspiration. According to the press release, the ceremony was attended by Punya Salila Srivastava, Secretary, Department of Health and Family Welfare; Rajat Kumar Mishra, Secretary, Department of Fertilizers, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers; Tejveer Singh, Secretary, Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals (DCPC), Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers; Rajiv Bahl, Secretary, Department of Health Research and Director General, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR); Lovneesh G. Krishna, Director General of Health Services (Dte.GHS) and Sunil Kumar Barnwal, CEO, National Health Authority (NHA) along with other senior officers and officials of both the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and the Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers. The pledge-taking ceremony reaffirmed the collective commitment of officers and officials towards upholding the unity, integrity and security of the nation. Rashtriya Ekta Diwas is observed every year on 31st October to honour the legacy of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel and reiterate the importance of national unity and solidarity. The observance served as an occasion to renew the commitment to the ideals of unity, integrity and national cohesion, which continue to guide the country's journey towards a developed and united India, the release said.
